terms.source: servo present-position, sync-read at ~50 Hz.  The 6 palm-pose columns are the arm, which the bench holds fixed, so they are constants -- and the 9 finger columns arrive at 0.44-0.90 of what was commanded on the yaw joints, which is the plant difference, not a sensing gap.

differenced servo positions.  Available but NOISY: the SCS0009 has no velocity register, the position quantum is 0.29 deg, and at 50 Hz that is 14.6 deg/s of quantisation on a signal the policy trained on as exact.
